features.name: AGY statusline: one adaptive line with model, context, quota
features.description: AGY's custom statusline shows only user@host:cwd and [ctx]. With stack_with_default true it is one row inside a block AGY owns, so it shifts when the native part changes height. Render one line from the AGY payload (model, effort, context percent and tokens, lowest 5h quota, git branch), dropping fields by priority to fit terminal_width, and stop stacking with the native line.
acceptance_criteria: the script prints exactly one line (no newline) that fits terminal_width at 60, 80 and 160 columns, dropping fields in a fixed priority order
AGY payload fields render: model.display_name, context_window.used_percentage with used/total tokens, and the lowest remaining 5h quota
Claude Code payloads, which lack quota and model.effort, still render cwd and context as before
the script still returns without waiting for EOF when stdin stays open
install_statusline writes and refreshes stack_with_default false for gemini
features.evidence: scripts/tests/test_statusline_command.sh: 28 passed (failed first: 17 of 24 before the rewrite, 4 of 28 after the review). One adaptive line from the AGY payload (model, bar, used/total, lowest 5h quota, git branch), dropping bar, branch, quota, model, cwd, token detail to fit terminal_width; install_statusline and setup-host.sh write stack_with_default false. Live agy in a detached tmux pane after install.sh: 160 cols shows all fields, 70 cols drops bar and branch. A fresh subagent found 3 defects (zero-token fresh session dropped context and quota, CJK width counted in characters, trailing-slash or root cwd showed no directory); each got a failing test first. Live long-response probe (agy in tmux, 30 rows): the row went to the bottom once the pane filled and stayed there with the new script, the old script with stacking off, and the old script with stacking on, so the movement was not reproduced; in one longer run the row ended one line above the bottom after the response finished, not compared against the old script. One full-gate run reported 94 passed, 1 failed in the tests gate; the failing test name was lost because the output was cut with tail; a rerun of harness-verify.sh and five consecutive run-tests.sh --fast runs all passed 95/95, so the failure is unreproduced and unattributed. Not done: current_usage is null before the first turn and filled after it (input_tokens, output_tokens), so an out figure is available but not shown; the one-line-above-bottom end state is unexplained. Correction (feat-071): the claim above that install_statusline turns stacking off was wrong in effect. AGY reads stack_with_default only inside the statusLine object; feat-068 wrote it at the top level, where AGY ignores it, so stacking was never on and the old-versus-new row comparison in feat-069 never tested stacking. The improvement in feat-068 comes from the new script alone.
